def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    c,(r,cc),bcomp=bracket(g)
    objs=[(col,comp) for col,comp in objects4(g) if comp!=bcomp]
    varm=[i for i,j in bcomp if j==cc]; harm=[j for i,j in bcomp if i==r]
    r0,r1=min(varm),max(varm); c0,c1=min(harm),max(harm)
    quad=lambda cell: r0<=cell[0]<=r1 and c0<=cell[1]<=c1
    inside=[(col,comp) for col,comp in objs if all(quad(cell) for cell in comp)]
    outside=[(col,comp) for col,comp in objs if not any(quad(cell) for cell in comp)]
    print('bracket color',c,'corner',(r,cc),'inside:',[(col,len(com)) for col,com in inside],'outside:',[(col,len(com)) for col,com in outside])
    target=None
    for col,comp in inside:
        s=norm(comp)
        for col2,comp2 in outside:
            if col2!=col and norm(comp2) in syms(s):
                target=(col2,comp2)
    assert target, "no twin"
    col2,comp2=target
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i,j in comp2: out[i][j]=c
    return out
